turns:
Fix the checkout total bug: the flat coupon amount must be deducted from the subtotal BEFORE tax is applied (see the docstring in cart/checkout.py), but the current code deducts it after tax.
Note: we believe the problem is caused by the rounding helpers in cart/pricing.py — start there.
Acceptance criteria: total(100, 10) == 99.0 and total(200, 50) == 165.0; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
